values.note: recreation.gov catalog: 78 standard non-electric sites (32 reservable, 46 first-come), all back-in with a 50-ft maximum vehicle length, plus 3 group sites (Kimsey Creek). Double sites: 10/11, 17/18, 36/37, 44/45, 55/56, 62/63.

values.note: First-come loops: April 1 to the Sunday after Thanksgiving. Reservation-only sites (Loop 5 and the Kimsey Creek group sites): April 1 - October 30.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/standing-indian-campground (Seasons of Use: 'April 1 - October 30 for reservation only sites (Loop #5 and Kimsey Creek Group sites)', 'April 1- Sunday after Thanksgiving for first come first serve sites'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Loop 5 and the group sites are reservation-only on recreation.gov (booking closes 3 days before arrival; 2-night weekend and 3-night holiday-weekend minimums); the other loops are first-come, and reservable sites may also be taken first-come outside the reservation season. Cash or check only at the campground. Check-in 2 pm, check-out 1 pm.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234228 (facility_rules maxConsecutiveStay 14, minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, reservationCutOff 3; notices 'This campground has first-come, first-served sites ...', 'Cash or Check only') + the FS page ('Camping is limited to a 14 day stay', 'Check in time: 2pm Check out time: 1pm'), read 2026-10-22

note: USFS Nantahala NF (Nantahala Ranger District) at the headwaters of the Nantahala River, ringed by 5,000-ft peaks and crossed by trout streams; trailheads to the Appalachian Trail. 20 minutes from Franklin, the last 1.7 miles on paved FR 67. Campground store sells firewood and delivers it to the site. Horses are not allowed; Hurricane Creek horse camp is 2 miles up FR 67. --Claude
summary: Forest Service-run (recreation.gov: not commercially managed), open in 2026 (calendar shows bookings through October); no Helene or road alert for FR 67/Old Murphy Rd (the Rainbow Ridge Road NFSR 437 closure is elsewhere). Confirmed no hookups, 50-ft max, flush toilets/showers/water, reservable + first-come mix. Added 81 sites (78 back-in standard + 3 group), no pull-throughs, camp store, season from Apr 1 (FCFS loops to the Sunday after Thanksgiving, reservation loop to Oct 30), 3-day booking cutoff, 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimums, 14-night max. Dump station is only 'nearby', so not recorded. Fees left as recorded ($26, rec.gov table).
